scope: Local queued-process disposal before archived artifact restoration.
baseline: Native R2/Queue regression failed: after confirmed vm.dispose and replacement Worker delivery, the process remained queued rather than cancelled because ProgramVersionPending requested another delivery before the disposal observer ran.
faultInjection: The test preserves the exact archived program bytes and digest, conditionally changes only its R2 format metadata to program-json-future, and verifies the write succeeded. This is controlled native format-mismatch injection, not evidence of an actual future runtime deployment.
implementation: A matching queued delivery checks the existing root lifetime before program/checkpoint restoration. A disposed or missing root uses the existing conditional terminal receipt publication to record cancelled, clearing authority/deadline/checkpoint and retaining output. Terminal lease settlement clears checkpoint references too. A losing conditional terminal write requests native Queue redelivery instead of claiming settlement.

validation.build: bun run build passed before native runtime tests.

nativeRegression.command: bun test tests/dispose.test.ts tests/process.test.ts tests/checkpoint.test.ts tests/stdin.test.ts

validation.nativeQueueReceipts: Live format-mismatched job returns outcome ok with explicit per-message 15-second retry, no acknowledgement and unchanged queued receipt ETag. After disposal and original Worker shutdown, the replacement returns outcome ok, explicit acknowledgement and no retry messages.
validation.terminalReceipt: StoredRun verifies cancelled status, no authority/deadline/checkpoint/output and a completed timestamp. Redelivery of the original event leaves the terminal object version unchanged.
validation.preservedBehavior: Existing process admission, duplicate claims, replacement recovery, lost observation/deadline handling, heap checkpoint integrity and interactive stdin suites passed.

limits: Selected native suites, not a new complete-suite or remote-CI run
No actual future-runtime rollout or obsolete heap execution was performed
No injected conditional-write conflict for this terminal branch; it uses native R2 ETag preconditions and existing native Queue retry handling
No atomic cross-object disposal transaction, immediate preemption, restart or object reclamation
No production latency/cost comparison or AgentOS cost advantage
No deploy, new Minutei delivery, GitHub action, push or publication
